brief:
Extreme right-wing Israeli Knesset member Tzvei Sokot breached Nur al-Huda school in the Ras Shehadeh area of Shaafat refugee camp in occupied Jerusalem for the second time, Shehab Wire reported. The incursion represents an escalation in tensions at the school, located in the northern Jerusalem neighborhood.

The invasion came as Israeli military and political movements continue across Palestinian territories. Sokot, a member of Israel's parliament, has previously targeted the school, underscoring a pattern of repeated access to the facility. The school serves students in the refugee camp community.
title: Israeli Knesset member invades Jerusalem school for second time
